query:
INSERT INTO object_state (
                object_path,
                key,
                program_path,
                program_version,
                schema_hash,
                state_json
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
            ON CONFLICT (object_path, key)
            DO UPDATE SET
                program_path = EXCLUDED.program_path,
                program_version = EXCLUDED.program_version,
                schema_hash = EXCLUDED.schema_hash,
                state_json = EXCLUDED.state_json,
                updated_at = NOW()
